brief: Goldman raises its HOOD 12-month price target 15% to $142 from $124 and stays Buy, on a sensitivity analysis of Rothera, the 45/45/10 HOOD/SIG/MIAX prediction markets exchange JV launched late May. The argument: Rothera has already reached the 3rd to 5th largest DCM by notional volume and produced $17mn of revenue in 41 days of 2Q26, roughly $151mn annualized at a 45-46% pre-tax margin, therefore SIG market making plus HOOD's ~14mn monthly actives plus the lowest DCM fee rates can deepen liquidity, draw other FCMs and lift both volume and take rate, therefore margins can scale toward the 55-70% of established exchanges. Applied to 2027E: base case $307mn revenue and $5.1-5.4bn equity value, bull $359-906mn and $6.7-19.5bn (32-258% upside), bear $91-242mn and $1.0-3.6bn (35-79% downside). Because HOOD trades at 39.3x FY+2 GSe P/E, the 87th percentile since 2021, backing Rothera out leaves the rest of HOOD at 39.2-39.3x in the base case and 37.0-38.9x in the bull, which Goldman reads as more attractive. GS sits 10%/14% above consensus on 2027E/28E prediction markets revenue and 3% above the Street on total revenue. Goldman takes no view on the outstanding prediction markets litigation.
